changelog: Add support for LuPhim site: update config to recognize luphim domains and add a custom LuPhim extractor in extractors/generic.py that parses iframe/embed (moviking) HTML, extracts videoId, calls moviking geturl API, builds streaming (m3u8) URLs and subtitle tracks, and returns an options entry. Use curl_cffi for API calls and add referer handling when resolving HLS/DASH size and DRM checks by introducing get_referer_by_url usage. Add multiple LuPhim HTML fixtures (luphim_page.html, luphim_iframe.html, luphim_streaming.html), test assets, thumbnails and analysis output. Also update helper imports (utils/helpers.py), adjust routes (routes/download.py, routes/info.py), static JS (static/js/main.js, streamLib.js) and task download logic (tasks/download.py) to support the new flow. Small safety/fallbacks and logging added; includes sample test files for debugging.
